title: Hunts FH-017S: Run the accessibility and low-signal script on real devices and record the results

source.ref: Split from FH-017 (2026-11-10): the script and pass rules shipped; the runs need the player (FH-016) and real devices.

detail: Run the twelve checks in docs/hunts/ACCESSIBILITY-REPORT.md on one iPhone and one Android phone against a published Trail with printed signs and tags, and write the dated results to docs/hunts/ACCESSIBILITY-RESULTS.md. Done when: every check is marked pass, fail with the rule it broke, or not run, and offline claims show pending with no silent awards. Requires: FH-015, FH-016. Owner role: Accessibility QA.
